name: BTC early-move fade context
description: Pairs the latest momentum from micro_momentum with the latest absorption_state. state is quiet when the absolute thirty-second return is below big_move_bps; the outsized classification uses the thirty-second return (a 30-second lookback and a 20 bps big_move_bps, both research defaults) rather than the one-second return, so outsized states are reachable on real data. On an outsized move, state is outsized_absorbing when absorption is absorbing (the fade-candidate context), outsized_responsive when price_responsive, and outsized_unclear for the remaining absorption states (insufficient_flow, mixed). The reading also carries return_bps_1s as one-second context, direction_10s, and absorption_state. Not ready until both inputs have emitted; readiness does not depend on a move occurring. big_move_bps defaults to 20. Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even.
